semiconductor_relevance: High — Sugino Machine specializes in advanced cutting and drilling equipment that is crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sugino Machine develops innovative cutting and drilling equipment utilizing a combination of laser technology and waterjet technology, aimed at enhancing precision and efficiency in semiconductor fabrication. Their products are designed to minimize thermal damage and burr formation while processing various semiconductor materials.
capabilities: High-pressure water beam cutting and drilling machines
Laser heads optimized for water beam machines
Automated transport and in-machine measurement systems
